#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int maxn = 6010, INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
int n, m, k, c, d, cnt, ans, a[maxn], x[maxn], y[maxn];
int head[maxn], pre[maxn], dist[maxn], inq[maxn];
queue<int> q;
struct edge { int to, cap, cost, nxt; } e[2000010];
int id(int t, int v) { return t * n + v; }

void add(int from, int to, int cap, int cost) {
    e[cnt] = (edge){to, cap, cost, head[from]}, head[from] = cnt++;
    e[cnt] = (edge){from, 0, -cost, head[to]}, head[to] = cnt++;
}

bool spfa(int s, int t) {
    fill(dist, dist + maxn, INF);
    q.push(s), dist[s] = 0;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int v = q.front(); q.pop(), inq[v] = 0;
        for (int i = head[v], u; ~i; i = e[i].nxt) {
            if (e[i].cap && dist[u = e[i].to] > dist[v] + e[i].cost) {
                dist[u] = dist[v] + e[i].cost, pre[u] = i;
                if (!inq[u]) q.push(u), inq[u] = 1;
            }
        }
    }
    return dist[t] < 1e9;
}

void upd(int s, int t) {
    for (int i = t; i != s; i = e[pre[i] ^ 1].to) {
        e[pre[i]].cap--, e[pre[i] ^ 1].cap++;
    }
    ans += dist[t];
}

int main() {
    memset(head, -1, sizeof(head));
    cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
    int S = 0, T = 6000;
    for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
        cin >> a[i], add(S, id(0, a[i]), 1, 0);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        cin >> x[i] >> y[i];
    }
    for (int t = 0; t <= 100; t++) {
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            add(id(t, i), id(t + 1, i), k, c);
        }
        add(id(t, 1), T, k, 0);
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= min(k, 25); j++) {
                add(id(t, x[i]), id(t + 1, y[i]), 1, c + (2 * j - 1) * d);
                add(id(t, y[i]), id(t + 1, x[i]), 1, c + (2 * j - 1) * d);
            }
        }
    }
    while (spfa(S, T)) upd(S, T);
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
